node.label: Paul Boyer
node.date_label: Salem Possessed (with Stephen Nissenbaum) (1974) · By the Bomb’s Early Light (1985) · When Time Shall Be No More (1992)
node.description: Historian of American culture whose studies ranged from Salem witchcraft to nuclear fears and apocalyptic belief. Ben Alpers reads Salem Possessed as a productive but limited application of social history to wealth and landholding,and By the Bomb’s Early Light as recovering both hopes and fears about atomic power. The subjects connect interpretation to social and moral conflict without defining a single Boyer school.
